page_title: NAP 1-1 GEN | Napoli v Genoa 17/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Juan Luca Sacchi is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Napoli, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+6' Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Juan Luca Sacchi blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Napoli in a dangerous position.
90+5' Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
90+3' The referee gives a yellow card to Vitinha (Genoa).
90+2' Alberto Gilardino prepares a substitution. Stefano Sabelli is replaced by Giorgio Cittadini (Genoa).
90+1' Substitution. Kevin Strootman (Genoa) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Ruslan Malinovsky walks off.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.

90' 1 - 1 Goal! Giovanni Di Lorenzo displays great vision and sends a pass to Cyril Ngonge (Napoli), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:1.
89' One of the players from Genoa times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
88' Napoli have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

87' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Josep Martinez easily deals with the threat. Napoli will take a corner kick.
85' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
84' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Genoa, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
83' Substitution. Albert Gudmundsson makes way for Vitinha (Genoa).
82' Juan Luca Sacchi interrupts the game. One of the players from Genoa won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Napoli win a free kick.

80' Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) controls the ball from the free kick on the edge of the box and releases a strike that could have ended up in the middle of the goal but for a magnificent save by Josep Martinez.
79' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
77' Juan Luca Sacchi has a clear sight and sees a foul from Frank Anguissa (Napoli). A free kick to Genoa.
75' Substitution. Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) in, Giovanni Simeone out.
75' Alberto Gilardino decides to make a substitution. Junior Messias will be replaced by Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa).
75' The manager makes a subsitution with Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) coming on for Mateo Retegui.

74' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) is quickest inside the box and leaps to connect with the resulting set piece. He produces a fine header, but it floats just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
74' Napoli force their opponents to concede a corner.
74' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Napoli, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Napoli earn a corner.
74' A player from Genoa commits a rough challenge. Juan Luca Sacchi blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Napoli will take a free kick.
71' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Napoli.
70' The goalkeeper pulls off a save to deny Cyril Ngonge (Napoli), whose low effort is only aimed at the middle of the goal.
68' Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) commits a rough foul. Juan Luca Sacchi stops the game and makes a call. Genoa have been awarded a free kick.
65' A substitution has been made. Pasquale Mazzocchi is replaced by Mathias Olivera (Napoli).
65' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
61' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Napoli comes to nothing.
59' Walter Mazzarri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jesper Lindstrom (Napoli) replacing Hamed Junior Traore.
59' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) replaces Matteo Politano.
58' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

57' Josep Martinez stretches to his left and makes a brilliant save! Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper inside the right post. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Napoli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
54' Juan Luca Sacchi shows a yellow card to Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.

52' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
50' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Juan Luca Sacchi didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.

48' 0 - 1 A superb goal from great team play! Morten Frendrup (Genoa) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent shot inside the left post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
47' Genoa can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
46' Aaron Martin (Genoa) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play and Genoa manage to earn a corner.
46' Walter Mazzarri has made a change at the break. Natan has come on in place of Leo Ostigard (Napoli).
46' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

45+2' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. Napoli have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Mattia Bani (Genoa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

43' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
42' The main referee, Juan Luca Sacchi, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) is given a yellow card for dissent.
40' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle for a foul after Mateo Retegui (Genoa) hacks down one of his opponents. A free kick has been awarded to Napoli.
39' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) sends a chip pass into the box, but Josep Martinez is quickest to intercept the ball.

37' Hamed Junior Traore (Napoli) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
34' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Josep Martinez intercepts the ball.
32' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Mateo Retegui (Genoa) inside the box. He lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Alex Meret was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
29' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
29' Leo Ostigard (Napoli) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
29' The corner is swung in but Genoa can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
28' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
28' The game is interrupted now, Leo Ostigard (Napoli) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

27' What a save from Alex Meret! Mateo Retegui (Genoa) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out. Genoa force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
26' Leo Ostigard (Napoli) sees a yellow card from Juan Luca Sacchi after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
25' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
25' Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) outjumps his marker inside the box and heads the resulting corner way wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
24' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
24' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball goes out for a corner. Napoli can continue in their attacking effort.
24' Matteo Politano (Napoli) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
23' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
23' Junior Messias (Genoa) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Alex Meret comes off the line to clear the ball away.
22' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Josep Martinez stops the ball from going inside right post.
20' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Genoa was in an offside position.
19' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
18' One of the Genoa players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. That's a free kick to Napoli.

15' Josep Martinez makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Frank Anguissa (Napoli) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the bottom right corner.
15' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
14' Hamed Junior Traore (Napoli) controls a cross inside the six-yard box, but sends his shot slightly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
13' Napoli are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
9' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle for a foul. Genoa have a free kick.
8' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.

7' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the bottom left corner. Alex Meret shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.

6' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
5' Junior Messias (Genoa) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball. A free kick is awarded to Napoli.
4' Juan Luca Sacchi blows for a foul after Morten Frendrup (Genoa) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. A free kick has been awarded to Napoli.

3' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to rifle a shot low into the middle of the goal, but Josep Martinez makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.
2' Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Napoli will take the kick-off.
Juan Luca Sacchi is the one to supervise the game today.
